newsitem.title: USA: Superior in $325 mln deal with Sprint unit.
newsitem.headline: Superior in $325 mln deal with Sprint unit.

text.p: Superior TeleCom Inc said Wednesday that it has signed an estimated $325 million five year agreement for the sale of copper telephone cable to Sprint North Supply, a unit of Sprint Corp.
The agreement, said the company, provides that Superior will supply Sprint North Supply's requirements for telephone cable over the next five years.
The contract, said the companies, formalizes long-standing ties between them.
Superior TeleCom makes telecommunications cable and wire products for regional Bell operating companies, independent telephone companies, distributors and systems integrators.
Sprint North Supply distributes cable and other telecommunications products.
